name: GPS
description: Neutral GPS tracking module. Provides geolocation access, position events and track storage.

permissions.description: Allows a user to see the GPS module in the workspace.
Allows a user to request positions and start GPS tracking.
Allows a user to manage GPS-related module settings.
Allows a user to administer the GPS module lifecycle and role assignments.

standalone.label: GPS standalone test
standalone.description: Loads the GPS module with lightweight local shims for UI and browser geolocation checks without the full application shell.

admin.title: GPS settings
admin.description: Controls for browser geolocation behaviour and local GPS data handling.

settings.label: Enable high accuracy
settings.description: Ask the browser for the most precise available position.

settings.label: Location timeout (ms)
settings.description: Maximum time the module waits for a geolocation response.

settings.label: Cached position age (ms)
settings.description: How old a cached GPS position may be before the browser must refresh it.

settings.label: Persist location history
settings.description: Store GPS positions in the local framework storage for later reuse.
